say:2:1810627001:0.text: I heard that customs in Bantus differ from ours in Novaris. Is that true?
say:2:1810627001:0.source_cn: 听闻班题斯的习俗与诺珐斯不同，是真的吗？

say:3:1810627002:0.text: There are differences, but they are not entirely worlds apart.
say:3:1810627002:0.source_cn: 有所区别，却也没到天差地别的程度。

say:4:1810627003:1.text: Back when Bantus was still ruled by the living, it was common for people who turned into Graveborn after death, like myself, to migrate to Novaris. A bit of cultural blending was inevitable.
say:4:1810627003:1.source_cn: 在班题斯还由生者统治的时候，常有像我这样死后变成亡灵的...

say:5:1810627004:1.text: Come to think of it, there used to be a massive stretch of unclaimed land between Bantus and Novaris. A shame it has all been conquered by Bantus now.
say:5:1810627004:1.source_cn: 想当时，班题斯和诺珐斯之间还存在着一大片无主之地，可惜...

say:6:1810627005:1.text: Had we known they would be this aggressive, we should have urged Her Ladyship to claim it first. Now we are entirely on the defensive.
say:6:1810627005:1.source_cn: 早知道他们这么强势，咱们真该劝领主阁下抢先一步，现在就...

say:7:1810627006:1.text: Save your breath. The past rulers of Novaris have never had any interest in territorial expansion.
say:7:1810627006:1.source_cn: 省省吧，诺珐斯的历任领主对扩张领土都没兴趣。

say:8:1810627007:1.text: Well, there is no use crying over spilled milk. If Her Ladyship truly accepts Bantus' terms, I will just have to look to you for lessons on Bantus noble etiquette.
say:8:1810627007:1.source_cn: 如今说这些都没用了。如果领主阁下真要接受班题斯的条件，...

say:9:1810627008:1.text: We will cross that bridge when we get to it. For now, you'd better strictly <style="highlight">observe the etiquette of Novaris</style>, and avoid embarrassing yourself.
say:9:1810627008:1.source_cn: 等真到了那一步再说吧。现在还是老老实实<style=h...

say:13:1810627009:0.text: Hmph. I expected the Graveborn of Novaris to have more backbone than that.
say:13:1810627009:0.source_cn: 哼，我还以为诺珐斯的亡灵会更有骨气呢。

choice_prompt:15:1810627013.source_cn: 不，除非你想惹祸上身。而且幻象没有告诉我们班题斯的礼节是什么。
